question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word from the given options.

The new government allowed all the corrupt ministers to feel the __sufficiency__ of money by banning the specific currency.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sufficiency"** means an adequate amount or quantity of something; enough for the purpose. (पर्याप्तता)

 
 
• **Example: **There is a **sufficiency** of food for everyone in the village.
 
 
 
• **"Dearth"** refers to a scarcity or lack of something; an insufficient quantity. (अभाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The** dearth **of clean drinking water is a major issue in many parts of the world.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'sufficiency' **is **'dearth'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Indeficiency** (अपर्याप्तता): This term is not commonly used in English; the correct term would be "insufficiency."

 
 
• **Example:** The indeficiency in his work led to several mistakes.
 
 
 
• **Plenty** (प्रचुरता): A large or sufficient amount or quantity.
 
 
• **Example: **We have plenty of time to finish the project.
 
 
 
• **Enough** (पर्याप्त): As much or as many as required.
 
 
• **Example:** She didn't have enough money to buy the dress.
 
 

3f:Tb49,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
